# Ground materials

Unmodified 1K PBR maps, included locally for offline rendering. Color uses sRGB; OpenGL normal and roughness use linear data.

- Marble012: https://ambientcg.com/a/Marble012 (CC0 1.0, https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/). Studio coverage 700 mm is an artistic recommendation, not a measured scan dimension.
- Smooth Concrete Floor, White Oak Veneer, Rough Linen: https://polyhaven.com/license (CC0 1.0).

See sources.json for each original URL, authors, scan dimensions when available, archive entries and SHA-256.
